description:
Chat about your life. Let another language become part of it.

Vipi introduces another language into conversations that already matter to you. Words and phrases alternate in place between their familiar meaning and your immersion language. Adjust how much you see and the pace that feels comfortable.

Keep one clear conversation
Read the original message or explore a mix of both languages. Approved local words and short phrases switch in place; unmatched text stays familiar. Reading guides help you follow supported writing systems, and local voices let you hear pronunciation. Available vocabulary, reading guides and voices depend on your languages and downloads. Where supported, you can also request a complete on-device translation.

Talk with your friends
Connect through usernames and invitations. Chats with friends are end-to-end encrypted. Translation and immersion run on your device. Save an encrypted history backup to a location you choose.

Meet vBot when you want more conversation
Bot mini is an optional additional plan for chatting with vBot. Messages you choose to send to vBot are processed by our response provider. Its monthly reply allowance is shown before subscribing.

Subscriptions
Vipi and Bot mini are separate annual subscriptions. A one-month free trial is available to eligible subscribers for each plan. You choose each subscription separately; Bot mini requires an active Vipi subscription. Your store shows the localized price, trial eligibility and renewal date before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your store. Existing local history remains available to read and export after a subscription ends.
